I got this game for like.... $8. Took me about 20 minutes to find out how to join a squad after joining a server. Played for like 30 minutes only to find out that the soldier dude I got, can't jump, can't crawl, can't really do more than running around. 10000 annoying doushes giving whatever orders over their microphone, confusing as hell (I was never ready for this War in the first place).
But now with all honesty and respect to the developers. This game is a JOKE, it's looks crappy, sounds aweful, feels sluggish, makes no friggin sense to people who actually want to focus on a war campaign and overall makes me furious. I cannot understand why people pay up to 40 bucks for this aweful game and spend hours and hours walking around in the grassland, listening to whatever clown ordering stuff and shouting at other players like this was IT (The real thing), the dude I got paired with was... I think he was an authist or something similar, he could only turn right for some reason and his aim was outperformed by his own butt. After a few terrible and absolutely pointless deaths I decided to 'jump' on an helicopter... 'Jump' cause thats how you do it basically in this game, why even bother with giving the player a visual on what key to press to mount on a heli (took me forever to figure out devs were even to lazy to integrate a feature like that), just to fly into a highly protected area where tons of misiles are launched at the speed of light at my machine (Mayday! - but no, you die on the spot, no action packed 'try to save the crew' action to be found there).
Overall (after around 30 minutes) I concluded this game to be one of the worst and overpriced pieces of digital garbage that I have ever had the chance to play.
This game is similar to Apple products. People buy that stuff not because it's good but because everyone has it just to find out that it's total crap and never play it anyways.
